data.notes: Purple: event source. Implementation today: Vector agents. vector/agent-windows.yaml reads the Security, System and PowerShell/Operational event logs; vector/agent-linux.yaml reads journald and auditd. Installed by scripts/install-windows-agent.ps1 and docs/host-ingestion.md.

devices.label:
Cluster log shipper [AU-12]
Role: per-node daemon forwards every container's
logs over an authenticated HTTP event API

data.notes: Purple: event source. Implementation today: Vector DaemonSet k8s/vector-shipper.yaml sending Splunk HEC on 8088 with a token. The local k3s demo is an optional test producer.

devices.label:
Cloud audit logs - OPTIONAL [AU-12]
Role: control-plane, threat, network-flow and access
logs in object storage; a queue announces each object

data.notes: Purple: optional event source. Implementation today: AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs and S3 server access logs in S3, one SQS queue per log type. docs/aws-ingestion.md.

devices.label:
Push pipeline - always on [AU-3]
Role: receive agent and HTTP events, route by source,
normalise to typed rows, disk-buffer, batch-load

data.notes: Teal: ingestion. Implementation today: Vector 0.61.0 in the ironlog-vector image with IRONLOG_VECTOR_ROLE=hosts (vector/hosts.yaml): vector source on 6000, splunk_hec source on 8088, VRL remap transforms, 2 GiB disk buffers that block when full, ClickHouse sinks.

devices.label:
Pull pipeline - OPTIONAL [AU-3]
Role: consume the notification queue, fetch objects,
normalise to typed rows, disk-buffer, batch-load

data.notes: Teal: optional ingestion. Implementation today: Vector 0.61.0 with IRONLOG_VECTOR_ROLE=aws (vector/vector.yaml): aws_s3 sources fed by SQS, VRL remap transforms, disk buffers, ClickHouse sinks. Off by default: Compose profile aws, Quadlet ships disabled, Helm vector.aws.enabled.

devices.label:
Event tables - hot tier [AU-11]
Role: one typed columnar table per source; bloom-filter
and full-text indexes; age-based deletion (TTL)

data.notes: Blue: data. Implementation today: ClickHouse 26.8.34.13 LTS MergeTree tables in the siem database (clickhouse/ddl/010_aws.sql, 020_hosts.sql). Text index idx_msg_text on windows_events, linux_syslog and k8s_logs; siem.log_search view in 050_search.sql. Retention is 30 days with the cold tier off, 400 with it on (images/README.md).

devices.label:
Cold tier - OPTIONAL [AU-4]
Role: tiered storage moves older data parts
to S3-compatible object storage

data.notes: Blue: optional data tier. Implementation today: ClickHouse S3 disk and storage policy, switched on by IRONLOG_S3_TIER=on with IRONLOG_HOT_DAYS; the image generates config.d/20-storage-s3.xml at start. Live-tested 2026-11-04 against an S3-compatible store; real AWS S3 untested; switching back off is unsupported.

devices.label:
Query audit trail - 2-year TTL [AU-9]
Role: a materialized view copies every finished
query from the database's own query log

data.notes: Blue: data. Implementation today: audit.query_archive filled by query_archive_mv from system.query_log (clickhouse/ddl/030_audit.sql). Attribution is to the shared service identities, not to individual UI users.

Blue: access control. Implementation today: ClickHouse roles siem_ingest (svc_vector), siem_analyst (svc_grafana_analyst) and siem_auditor (svc_grafana_auditor), profile siem_reader (clickhouse/ddl/040_rbac.sql).

devices.label:
Visualisation and alerting UI [AU-5, AU-6]
Role: dashboards, free-text search, ad-hoc SQL and
per-source silence alerts; the only UI

data.notes: Amber: application. Implementation today: Grafana OSS 13.3.0 with ClickHouse plugin 4.23.4 (ironlog-grafana image) on port 3000; Log Search dashboard over siem.log_search; seven AU-5 ingestion-silence alert rules; analyst and auditor datasources.

devices.label:
Schema migration job - one-shot [AU-9]
Role: applies tables, identities and retention,
verifies them, then lets the other services start

data.notes: Amber: one-shot job. Implementation today: the ironlog-schema command of the ironlog-clickhouse image (Quadlet ironlog-schema.service, Compose service schema, Helm post-install/upgrade hook Job).
Purple: people. docs/local-auth.md.

devices.label:
Pipeline image
Role: one image, two roles (push or pull),
chosen by an environment variable

data.notes: Slate: image. Implementation today: ironlog-vector:0.61.0 (images/vector/Dockerfile), IRONLOG_VECTOR_ROLE=hosts or aws.
Slate: image. Implementation today: ironlog-clickhouse:26.8.34.13 (images/clickhouse/Dockerfile).

devices.label:
UI image
Role: visualisation server, database connector,
dashboards and alert rules baked in

data.notes: Slate: image. Implementation today: ironlog-grafana:13.3.0 with ClickHouse plugin 4.23.4 (images/grafana/Dockerfile).

devices.label:
Host service manager [VERIFIED]
Role: containers run as system services on one
host, or split with the database on its own host

data.notes: Slate: runtime. Implementation today: podman Quadlets on Oracle Linux 9 (quadlets/), live-tested 2026-11-04 single host and two-host split with SELinux enforcing.

devices.label:
Developer compose stack
Role: builds the images locally and runs
the whole stack on one workstation

data.notes: Slate: runtime. Implementation today: docker-compose.yml through scripts/compose.sh; podman by default, Docker selectable.
Slate: runtime. Implementation today: Helm chart deploy/helm/ironlog, CI on kind (.github/workflows/helm.yml); OpenShift SCC and Routes are not exercised by CI.

devices.label:
Managed container service - PLANNED
Role: not built yet; named as a wave-2
target in the image contract

data.notes: Grey: planned, not implemented. Amazon ECS on EC2 per images/README.md; deploy/ecs/ does not exist yet.
Grey: legacy, still in the repository. Packer EC2 AMI (packer/, scripts/build-ami.sh), RHEL 9 shipping and Rocky 9 development.
